# RxCe

> > RxCe is an ACPE, ACCME, and ANCC-accredited continuing education platform offering pharmacy, physician, and healthcare professional courses with automated credit reporting to CPE Monitor and CE Broker.

RxCe provides accredited continuing education courses designed for pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, physicians, and physician assistants. The platform features live webinars, certificate programs, and on-demand courses covering disease management and clinical topics, with seamless integration to major credit tracking systems.

## Key Topics

- ACPE accreditation
- Continuing education credits
- Pharmacy technician courses
- Pharmacist courses
- CPE Monitor integration
- CE Broker reporting
- Live webinars
- Disease state management
- ACCME CME credits
- Certificate programs
- Unlimited membership
- AAPA Category 1
- AMA PRA Category 1
- Accredited training
- Clinical pharmacy education

## Pharmacy Continuing Education

- [Pharmacist Courses](https://rxce.com/CourseList/Pharmacist): Browse accredited pharmacist CE courses with CPE Monitor and CE Broker integration
- [Pharmacy Technician Courses](https://rxce.com/CourseList/Pharmacy-Tech): Accredited pharmacy technician CE courses covering disease management and patient safety
- [Certificate Programs](https://rxce.com/CertificatePrograms): ACPE-approved certificate programs including diabetes and nonsterile compounding training
- [Live Webinars](https://rxce.com/Live): ACPE-approved live webinars for pharmacists and pharmacy technicians via GoToWebinar

## Physician & Healthcare Professional Courses

- [Physician CME Courses](https://rxce.com/CourseList/Physician): ACCME-accredited CME courses for physicians with AMA PRA Category 1 credits
- [Physician Assistant Courses](https://rxce.com/CourseList/Physician-Assistant): ACCME-accredited CME courses for physician assistants with AAPA Category 1 credits
